startup.title: This browser's vault cannot be opened
startup.explanation: Nothing has been deleted. It may be a temporary browser lock, private browsing, or a vault created by a newer version of the app.
startup.temporaryBanner: Temporary in-memory vault: everything here is lost when the tab closes. Use “Emergency export” before leaving.

library.title: Library
library.purgeConfirm: Permanently delete “{{title}}” and all its versions? This cannot be undone. Make a backup first if you need one.
library.trashFolder: Move folder to trash (its content is not deleted)
library.recoveryHint: Documents whose folder is in the trash or no longer exists. Move them to another folder.

readOnly.unsupported-version: This document uses a newer format version than this app. It is shown read-only so nothing is lost.
readOnly.invalid-content: This document does not match the expected format. It is shown read-only; see “Status and diagnostics”.

notes.invalidFrontmatter: This note's frontmatter is not valid; it is kept as text.

statusPanel.title: Status and diagnostics
statusPanel.persistedNo: No: the browser may delete data if it needs space
statusPanel.quotaHigh: Storage is almost full. Make an emergency export and free some space.
statusPanel.backupNote: Browser storage is not a substitute for a backup.
statusPanel.emergencyExportHint: Downloads all local content (documents, versions and files) as a single JSON file. Interim until the ZIP backup.
statusPanel.diagnosticsHint: Kept on this device only; it does not contain your notes' text.
statusPanel.licensesHint: This app is free software under the GNU AGPLv3 and includes third-party software and fonts. The aline name, logo, icons and stickers are not under that license: all rights reserved.

storageAlert.outOfSpace: Out of space: changes are NOT being saved.

errors.quota-exceeded: Browser storage is full. The change was NOT saved.
errors.storage-failure: Local save failed. The change was NOT saved.
errors.unsupported-version: Unsupported format version: the document is read-only.
errors.invalid-content: The content is invalid or damaged.

pwa.updateFailed: Not updated: some changes could not be saved.
pwa.offlineReady: The app is ready to work offline.

canvas.draftRecovered: A stroke left unfinished when the app closed was recovered.

history.title: Version history
history.hint: Every saved version is kept until you delete the document from the trash.

conflict.title: Resolve conflict
conflict.banner: This document has conflicting versions. None has been lost.
conflict.explanation: The same document changed in two places at once. Choose what to keep: the other versions stay in the history.
conflict.bothHint: {{a}} stays in this document and {{b}} is copied to a new document.
conflict.mergeEventsHint: Combines the events of all versions. If an event is in several, the most recent version wins; one deleted in a version comes back if another keeps it.

vaults.title: Vaults in this browser
vaults.backupHint: Downloads a ZIP with the whole vault in the open format: documents, history, trash and a manifest with each file’s SHA-256.
vaults.largeBackup: The backup is about {{mb}} MB. Creating it may use a lot of memory, especially on iPad. Continue?
vaults.restoreHint: Restoring creates a NEW vault with the backup’s content; the current vault is untouched.
vaults.restore: Restore a backup (ZIP or emergency JSON)…
vaults.identical: Verified: the restored content matches the backup byte for byte.
vaults.notIdentical: Warning: the restored content does not exactly match the backup.
vaults.problems: {{count}} warnings while reading the backup (see diagnostics).

links.searchPlaceholder: Find by title (notes, canvases, documents, calendars)
links.eventsError: The calendar could not be opened.
links.anchorApproximate: The linked text changed: showing the paragraph where it was.
links.anchorLost: The linked passage is no longer in the document.

search.title: Search
search.placeholder: Search notes, titles, tags and canvases

storage.title: Where it is stored
storage.browserOnly: In this browser only. Connect a folder to keep the vault on disk and open it from other computers.

phase.pending_one: {{count}} version pending to write to the folder
phase.pending_other: {{count}} versions pending to write to the folder
phase.needs-permission: needs permission to use the folder
phase.needs-confirm: the encrypted copy was replaced by an unencrypted one

storage.connectFolder: Connect a folder on this computer…
storage.folderUnsupported: This browser cannot pick folders (it needs Chrome or Edge on a computer). On iPad the vault lives in the browser; use ZIP backups.
storage.folderHint: The folder receives the open format: Markdown notes readable with any editor, versions and copies. You can edit the copies in “readable/”: they are imported as new versions. Do not use the Google Drive desktop folder and the direct Drive connection at the same time.
storage.mismatch: The folder “{{folder}}” contains another vault (“{{vault}}”). They are not mixed: you can open it in this browser as a separate vault.
storage.driveNotConfigured: Google Drive: this build has no OAuth client ID (VITE_GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID).

drivePhase.mismatch: the Drive folder contains another vault
drivePhase.unavailable: the Drive folder is not available (another account or in the trash?)
drivePhase.needs-key: needs the password of the encrypted vault
drivePhase.needs-confirm: the encrypted copy was replaced by an unencrypted one: decide before continuing

storage.driveWarningTitle: Before connecting Google Drive: do you want to encrypt the content?
storage.driveWarning: Content is stored in your Google Drive as is: Google and anyone with access to your account can read it. In exchange, notes can be opened and edited from Drive, and there is no password to lose.
storage.driveReady: Google will open a window to choose the account and grant access.
storage.driveOthers: This Drive account has other vaults, but not this one. They are not mixed: you can open one of them in this browser as a separate vault or create a new folder for this one.
storage.driveCreate: Create a Drive folder for this vault
storage.driveNoRequestsYet: The app only asks for access to the files it creates itself (drive.file permission). No request has been made to Google until you press “Continue”.

enc.encryptedWarning: Content is encrypted on this device before upload: Google cannot read it. Each device will need the password once. If you forget the password and lose the recovery code, the Drive copy cannot be recovered (nobody can reset it). Notes cannot be read or edited from Drive, and the vault name and the number and size of files remain visible.
enc.recoveryText: If you forget the password, this code is the only way to open the encrypted vault. Keep it off this device (printed or in a password manager). It will not be shown again.
enc.recoveryFile: Recovery code for the encrypted Aline vault in Google Drive. Keep it safe: it works in place of the password.
enc.recoverySaved: I have saved the recovery code in a safe place
enc.modePlain: Not encrypted (Google can read the content)
enc.unlockText: This vault is encrypted in Drive. Enter its password (or the recovery code) to use it on this device; it is only asked once.
enc.wrong: The password or code is not correct.
enc.passwordChanged: Password changed. Devices already using this vault keep working without asking for it.
enc.recoveryReplaced: Recovery code replaced; the previous one no longer works.
enc.switchTitle: Change the vault mode in Drive
enc.switchToEncrypted: A new encrypted folder will be created and the whole vault uploaded (this may take a while). The current, unencrypted folder is not touched until the new one is complete; then you can move it to the trash. Note that Google could already read what was unencrypted, and Drive keeps the trash for a while.
enc.switchToPlain: A new unencrypted folder will be created and the whole vault uploaded. From then on Google can read the content. The encrypted folder is not touched until the new one is complete.
enc.previousFolder: The mode change finished: other devices will move to the new folder when they sync. The previous folder is no longer used.
enc.trashPrevious: Move the previous folder to the Drive trash
enc.existing-encrypted: This vault was already encrypted in Drive, so that folder is used; enter its password to unlock it.
enc.existingPlain: This vault is already in Drive UNENCRYPTED. Nothing has been uploaded yet. You can create a new encrypted folder with the password you just chose (the unencrypted copy is not touched; once the new one is complete you can move it to the trash) or use the existing unencrypted folder, where Google can read the content.
enc.relocatePlain: Another device removed encryption: the encrypted Drive copy was replaced by an UNENCRYPTED one. This device has not uploaded anything to that folder. If you accept it, pending changes will be uploaded there and Google will be able to read them; you can also encrypt again in a new folder.
enc.relocateReencrypt: Encrypt again in a new folder…

storage.revokeUnconfirmed: Disconnected on this device, but Google did not confirm that the app’s permission was removed (for example, because the page was reloaded since the last authorization). You can remove it in your Google Account security settings, under “Third-party apps & services”.

export.title: Export the canvas
export.tooBig: At this scale the image does not fit in the browser memory. Lower the scale (at most {{max}}×), export only the selection or use SVG. Nothing is cropped.
export.lossesTitle: Excalidraw has no equivalent for the following, which is not included in the file:

losses.internal-links_one: {{count}} link to a note or canvas in this vault: in Excalidraw it will lead nowhere.
losses.internal-links_other: {{count}} links to notes or canvases in this vault: in Excalidraw they will lead nowhere.
losses.product-semantics: Backlinks, version history, folders, tags and note identity. To keep everything, use the full backup (ZIP).

export.failed: Export failed. Try a lower scale or the selection only.
export.noNotes: There are no notes to export.

import.title: Import finished
import.droppedKeys: these frontmatter fields are not kept: {{keys}}
import.frontmatterAsText: the frontmatter was not recognised and was kept as text at the top of the note

issues.embedded-web-content: embedded web content not imported ({{count}}: {{types}}); it would load external pages
issues.unknown-element: elements of an unsupported type not imported ({{count}}: {{types}})
issues.missing-image: images without data ({{count}}): they will show as unavailable
issues.remote-image: images linked from the internet not imported ({{count}})
issues.deleted-elements: elements deleted in the original, not imported ({{count}})

profile.title: Profile
